description: Create a paired A/B experiment that tests ONE script variable (the hook) with two variants, each with a slug variantId (e.g. hook-aggressive; never "A"/"B"), a name and a style description you will follow when writing its hooks. Then call add_experiment_pair once per pair. Results come from get_experiment_results.

name.description: Experiment name, e.g. "Calm vs aggressive hook".

personaId.description: Persona every video of the experiment uses. Null or omitted = faceless experiment with no persona.

targetPairs.description: Pairs to publish (each pair = 2 charged videos). The result can only be "clear" once all pairs are in; with 6 pairs one variant must win all 6, a moderate effect needs about 10-12.

variants.description: Exactly two variants of the hook.

description.description: The style rule you will follow when writing this variant's hooks, e.g. "direct, provocative, calls out a mistake".

variantId.description: Slug that identifies the variant in results and PostHog, e.g. hook-aggressive.

name: create_experiment
